title: Measuring AI Leadership: Development and Validation of a Multidimensional Measure for AI-Native Organizations
abstract: arXiv:2609.17965v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI is changing what leaders must judge, explain, learn, and coordinate, yet existing measures do not capture these behaviors at the level needed to study leadership in AI-enabled work. We develop the AI Leadership Battery, which organizes 36 behaviorally specific subdimensions into 11 theory-specified content families. Following established scale-development procedures, the research used deductive item generation; content validation of definitional correspondence and definitional distinctiveness; exploratory factor analysis and item reduction; confirmatory factor analysis in independent samples; and tests of internal consistency reliability, convergent validity, discriminant validity, and criterion-related and incremental validity. Across the development and validation studies, the analyses provided evidence for the Battery's content, multidimensional structure, reliability, and distinction from selected orbiting constructs. The Battery

translated_title: 衡量AI领导力：面向AI原生组织的多维度测量工具的开发与验证
translated_abstract: AI正在改变领导者必须做出判断、进行解释、开展学习和实施协调的内容，然而现有的测量工具无法在研究AI赋能工作中的领导力所需的层面上捕捉这些行为。我们开发了“AI领导力量表”，该量表将36个行为特定的子维度组织为11个理论指定的内容族。遵循既定的量表开发程序，该研究采用了演绎式题目生成；对定义对应性和定义区分性进行内容验证；探索性因子分析与题目精简；在独立样本中进行验证性因子分析；以及内部一致性信度、聚合效度、区分效度、效标关联效度和增量效度的检验。在整个开发与验证研究中，分析结果为该量表的内容、多维结构、信度以及与相关构念的区别提供了证据。
tldr: 该研究开发并验证了一个包含36个子维度、11个内容族的多维度AI领导力量表，为研究AI原生组织中的领导力提供了首个系统化测量工具。
en_tdlr: This study develops and validates the AI Leadership Battery, a multidimensional measure comprising 36 behaviorally specific subdimensions across 11 content families, providing the first systematic instrument for studying leadership in AI-native organizations.
